Office of the Treasurer
ALCONA COUNTY TREASURER OFFICE
106 5th Street, P.O. Box 158
Harrisville, MI 48740 Phone (989) 724-9420
actreasurer@alc onacounty.gov
Office Hours Monday- Friday 8:30am to 4:30pm Closed for Lunch (12-1)
Sheila Scott - County Treasurer
Amy Otremba-Holmes - Chief Deputy Treasurer
Amy Beard - Deputy Treasurer Denna Reitz - Treasurer Assistant
The principal duties of the office are: collection of all delinquent property taxes, custodian of all county funds, conducts the public land auction of real estate delinquent two and one half years (2 1/2), receives and disburses state monies to the various units. Some of the other duties of the County Treasurer are: Certification of warranty deeds, handles the complete program of dog licenses, prepares and mails delinquent tax notices in connection with public land auction, issues tax histories and searches as required by lending organizations and individuals. D eposits all revenues that have been transmitted to the office.

Dog License
ALCONA COUNTY DOG LICENSE
*2027 DOG LICENSES ARE NOW AVAILABLE FOR EARLY PURCHASE*
All dog owners within the County of Alcona are required to register/license their dogs for 2026. (Michigan Law MCL 287.262) Dog licenses can be purchased at the Alcona County Treasurer Office, 989-724-9420. The County would appreciate the cooperation of all dog owners in the community in obtaining your 2026 dog license. Purchase your dog license with cash, check or credit/debit card.
CLICK HERE TO PURCHASE by Credit Card via All Paid
BEFORE MARCH 1 ST
$10.00 per dog – spayed/neutered
$15.00 per dog – unaltered
Kennel licenses are available
10 Dogs or less - $10.00
More than 10 Dogs - $25.00
All single licenses will double in price on March 1st
Kennel licenses will double on June 1st
* A COPY OF RABIES CERTIFICATE IS REQUIRED TO ISSUE A LICENSE
